display_name: Expenditure share of necessaries (Case I, analytic)

triage.reason: Renderable analytic curve (Shaikh Fig 3.4): the share-of-income form of the Case I necessaries construction, 119 clean points. Renders as an x-y curve over the income grid (carried in the 'year' index column, NOT calendar years). TRIAGE_PRESCREEN had no EMPTY flag for S302 but it shares the index-as-year pattern; L01/P02 exist and replicate.py builds it (PASS). Caveat: agent-chosen Case I calibration (DPR §7) governs levels, not the book; only the shape is faithful. KB gap: ch03 not HDARP-extracted, so the ch3 figure quotes are unverifiable and 'From the book' is omitted.

field_fixes.year_column_is_index: Chopped 'year' is a point index, not a calendar year; abscissa is income (model units). Viz plots value vs income grid.
